angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,448,447 km at 182.19 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.4889 +/- 0.0237 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 182.19 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 2.082 +/- 0.022 solar radii from Hooton et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of MASCARA-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract): 1,448,447 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.9 +/- 0.063 solar masses from Hooton et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of MASCARA-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 7490 +/- 150 K from Hooton et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of MASCARA-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Hooton et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of MASCARA-1 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/mascara-1.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.080, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of MASCARA-1 (pscomppars): spectral type A8, from Talens et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...606A..73T/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 201585: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of MASCARA-1 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.15 dex, from Hooton et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of MASCARA-1 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 1.08279, from Hooton et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of MASCARA-1 (pscomppars): age 0.8 Gyr, from Hooton et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of MASCARA-1 (pscomppars): rotation period 0.853 d, from Hooton et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of MASCARA-1 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 101.7 km/s, from Hooton et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022A&A...658A..75H/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (2.082 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.824. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
